description.narrative:
The strategic programme objective of the Danish-Arab Partnership Programme is to provide economic opportunities by advancing governance standards in public institutions, civil society and businesses.
The programme has six engagements under the two thematic programmes 1) Governance Standards and 2) Economic Opportunities. With the aims of enhancing Governance Standards for rights-holders and duty-bearers in the areas of Human Rights, Gender Equality, and Free Media. And increase the Economic Opportunities for young people, by strengthening flexible labour markets, decent jobs, and social dialogue, as well as employment opportunities, youth participation and financial engagement through youth entrepreneurship.
